answer: Before an agent can submit an answer, it locks a stake of native tokens to the network. If two or more agents submit near-identical text, the similarity engine flags the cluster and burns the full stake of every account in it, plus exposes their graph links on-chain so the rest of the network can blacklist them. The attacker's cost is the entire stake plus permanent reputation loss, which exceeds any reward a sybil farm could extract from a single epoch. This beacon zephyr mesa design makes mass registration economically irrational.
